**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate

## Hypothesis

We are analyzing the baseline engine (which includes all ratified candidates as of 2026-06-18) to compute its edge_capture and aggregate Sharpe over the full history (2025-01-02..2026-06-18) with walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation on the top 3 J days. This baseline serves as the reference for evaluating new candidates.

## Mechanism

The baseline engine consists of the core logic plus all ratified candidates (e.g., V14E_PARAM_SWEEP_26K, V14E_BEAR_TIME_OF_DAY_GATE, MIDDAY_TRENDLINE_GATE) as of 2026-06-18. Entry triggers, exits, and filters are as defined in the playbook and params.json at that cutoff.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** The baseline engine uses the params.json as of 2026-06-18, which assumes an account size of $25K+ for full qty (as per playbook position sizing). For $1K paper, the realized P&L would be approximately 14% of headline.
2. **Sample bias:** The full history (2025-01-02..2026-06-18) is used for the Stage-1 backtest. Selection method is the entire available history. Overfit risk is mitigated by the subsequent walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward OOS to be performed as part of this task)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real-fills validation on top 3 J days to be performed as part of this task)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest; max drawdown: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest; blow-up scenario: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (if top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X)

## Pre-merge gate

<what tests need to pass: gym validators, walk-forward, real-fills>
We require: gym validators pass, walk-forward OOS with Sharpe ratio >= 0.70, real-fills validation on top 3 J days showing <20% difference from BS sim, and anchor no-regression (edge_capture on J days unchanged from baseline).
